subject: Copywriting
title: Email vs. Social Media ROI
description: A micro-lesson that makes Email vs. Social Media ROI usable.

hook.text: Email generates $36 for every $1 spent. Social media generates $2.80. Email outperforms social by 12x.

buildup.text: Social platforms control reach. Facebook shows your post to 5% of followers. Email reaches 85-90% of inboxes.

discovery.text: Email converts 3x better than social media for purchases. The private inbox creates focused, undistracted reading.

twist.text: Despite the data, most brands spend 10x more on social than email. Marketing budgets follow trends, not ROI.

climax.text: Smart marketers use social to grow the email list, then email to drive revenue. The funnel ends in the inbox.

punchline.text: $36 return per $1 spent. Email is the ROI king.

quiz.question: What is the average ROI of email marketing?
